# Team introduction

Model: `team`. Each call creates a complete slide. Inter, geometry and text sizes are fixed.

[Model index](../../../templates/MODELS.md) · [Palette and content guide](../../STUDIO-MODELS.md)

```latex
\studiosetup{palette=light}
\studiotemplate[variant=collage]{team}
```

Palette switches are available only where the original composition exists in both colours.
Unsupported explicit choices fail. A global palette leaves special compositions in their native treatment.

## Variants and named fields

### collage

Original palettes: light.

[Current source](../../../templates/studio/team-presentation.tex) · [Full slot guide](../guides/team-presentation.md)

| Field | Default | Available space |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value-one` | <code>50+</code> | 14.2% wide × 10.4% high |
| `caption-one` | <code>Active members</code> | 14.8% wide × 4.5% high |
| `value-two` | <code>210</code> | 11.9% wide × 10.4% high |
| `caption-two` | <code>Alumni</code> | 11.7% wide × 4.5% high |
| `value-three` | <code>8000+</code> | 23.3% wide × 10.4% high |
| `caption-three` | <code>Followers on social media</code> | 24.1% wide × 4.5% high |
| `value-four` | <code>25+</code> | 16.4% wide × 10.4% high |
| `caption-four` | <code>Industry members</code> | 16.7% wide × 4.5% high |
| `collage` | <code>\includegraphics[width=988\studiounit]{images/studio/team/collage.pdf}</code> | 51.5% wide × 100.0% high |

Graphic slots also accept named `icon-one`, `image-one`, `graphic-one` keys (then two, three, …), following their stable slot numbers. See the full slot guide for position and bounds.

Omitted fields retain these descriptive defaults; empty values retain their allocated space. Numbers and charts are illustrative.

## Complete one-slide example

```latex
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}
\usetheme{bitpolito-studio}
\usepackage{bitpolitostudiotemplates}
\usepackage[backend=biber]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{bibliography.bib}
\begin{document}
\studiotemplate[
  variant={collage},
  palette={light},
  value-one={50+},
  caption-one={Active members}
]{team}
\end{document}
```
